content.summary: If you're wondering how Alex Ridha's (aka Boys Noize) collaboration with Nine Inch Nails influenced his new record 7LLVSION, the answer is simple: It didn't. That's not to say Ridha didn't learn anything from the virtuosic production team of Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross, but most of the songs on 7LLVSION had been knocking around for some time. And as Ridha is quick to point out, these are not rock songs built for live performance; they're "battle tested" for clubs and DJ sets. "I was kind of back on the usual kind of thing," he tells The Verge. "I do the same I kind of always do.
